info.title: Our Ground Pennsylvania pilot API
info.description: Proposed contract only. Not a running API. Food assistance in Pennsylvania; fixture organizations are fictional. Authorization, workflow and business validation must be implemented server-side.

post.summary: Approve or request changes on the submitted version
post.description: Independent reviewer/admin only; reject own submission or any membership in the subject organization. Require pending_review and matching expected_version under a row lock. Snapshot exact content and append review in the same transaction. Approve sets approved_version, last_verified_at=server time and expiry=server time+30 days. Request_changes clears verification. No content version increment.
